description:
An intuitive video editor for every skill level.

Filmora is an intuitive video editor for every skill level. Filmora makes it easy for anyone to be creative. Jump into an editing experience where advanced features are simple and fun. We got rid of repetitive tasks so you can devote your energy to your imagination. Get inspired by Filmora, an editor designed for creators like you.
To Our Creators

Thank you for trusting us with your moments and ideas. We are even more grateful that you never hesitated to speak up — every crash report, honest suggestion, and the time you spent with us in interviews became a keyframe on our shared timeline, keeping us moving forward.

That is why this update carries your voice in every frame.

What’s new in Filmora V16.0.9:

1. AI Media Analysis: Automatically identifies key media information and generates structured insights and editing timestamps to speed up media selection and rough cuts.

2. Enhanced Media Management: Organize your media with folders, missing file recovery, metadata, tags, notes, and Smart Media Folders for faster, more efficient search and management.

3. Scan to Upload: Transfer media from your phone directly to your desktop project by scanning a QR code.

4. Batch Export: Select multiple export presets at once and quickly export videos in different formats.

5.  360° Video Reframing: Adjust viewpoints and apply motion presets to create immersive 360° video edits.

6. Color Mask: Use masks to isolate specific areas, adjusting their color and tone independently for more precise local color grading.

7. Auto Color: Automatically optimize your video’s colors with intelligent algorithms and adjust the overall tone with one click for a more polished look.

8. New Shortcut Management: View shortcut conflicts at a glance, quickly search for commands, and customize or migrate shortcut presets for a faster, more intuitive editing workflow.

9. Camera Tracking: Automatically track a person or custom target to keep your subject accurately tracked and create smooth, dynamic motion.

10. Smart Text Correction: Makes subtitle proofreading faster and easier.

11. Perspective Text: Add perspective to titles for a stronger sense of depth and more dynamic visuals.

12. Dynamic Captions Upgrade: Added tag-based categories, Single Character and Long Sentence filters, Favorites, preset saving, and support for generating Dynamic Captions directly during STT.

13. Video Animation Upgrade: Added Combo animations to fill the mid-clip motion gap, support for using In, Out, and Combo animations together, and animation resource search.

14. Multi-Source Recording: Screen Recording now supports Multi-Source Recording, allowing you to capture multiple screens, webcams, and microphones simultaneously for more flexible presentations and content creation.

15. Game Recording: Capture gameplay at its actual frame rate for a more accurate representation of in-game performance, while recording game audio and commentary at the same time.

16. Customizable Properties Panel: Customize your property panel by removing less-used controls and keeping your most frequently used tools for a cleaner, smoother editing experience.

17. Track Matte: Use another track to control the visible area of the current track, enabling more flexible multi-track compositing and creative effects.

18. Open Timeline Format XML Import and Export: Import and export XML timeline projects for interchange with other professional video editing software, enabling smoother cross-application workflows.

19. Motion Blur for Keyframes: After adding keyframes to Position, Scale, or Rotation, enable Motion Blur to create smoother, more natural motion and make fast movements and transitions feel less abrupt.

Notes: Projects saved in this version may not be compatible with earlier versions of Filmora. If you need to roll back to an earlier version, please make sure you have a backup of your project.

Let's keep editing stories worth telling.

– The Filmora Team
